status: Post-failure robustness analysis. NOT a blind preregistration; first actual source-bin negative area was already seen in researcher log. No other source bin data or observed DES gamma_t residuals have been inspected.
science_question: Quantify the exact sensitivity of the purely geometric source-behind lens redshift ordering integral to signed calibrated DES NZ_SOURCE arrays rather than changing the frozen nonnegative source distribution threshold.

methods.signed: Normalize actual FITS signed source redshift response arrays by their positive signed total A-B; do not clip and do not reinterpret signed arrays as literal probability distributions.
methods.nonnegative_comparison: Independently normalize max(raw_nz,0) to mass A, solely for diagnostic comparison; no claim it is scientifically preferred or the official DES calibration likelihood.
methods.geometry: Compute P_s[z_source>z_lens] and its native lens-redshift-supported sub-integrals as functionals of the above normalized source measures, with nonnegative original MagLim lens 4.
methods.quadrature: For z union grid, 4-point Gauss-Legendre integrates exactly the piecewise cubic product lens n(z) times normalized signed source survival, with verified no clipping of signed integrals.
methods.TV: Set epsilon=B/A. Signed measure to positive-part normalized measure TV=epsilon/(1-epsilon), so for any 0<=event<=1, |I_signed-I_positive| <= TV. This is not a physical source photo-z systematic bound.
methods.checks: Reject nonfinite data, nonmonotonic grids, nonpositive signed total, invalid original source data hash. Report all four bins and all ells before interpreting. Require exact synthetic bound checks.
methods.retained_failure: LW21_6_SYNTHETIC_PASS remains but LW21 real signedness threshold 1e-4 failed. Never relabel it PASS or alter threshold.

stop: No source physical lensing efficiency chi(z), no actual galaxy-shear likelihood, no eta calibration, no full Aeff, no detection. This is a separate signed-kernel sensitivity audit rather than an override of LW21.
